evidence: Deep within the bustling heart of Hà Đông District, in the celebrated weaving village of Vạn Phúc Ward, stands the majestic Van Phuc Communal House, known locally as Đình làng Vạn Phúc. This ancient structure, a testament to the enduring traditions of Vietnamese culture, was established centuries ago to honor A Lã Thị Nương, a revered female general from the Hai Bà Trưng era and the founder of the local silk weaving craft.

The Van Phuc Communal House is a striking architectural marvel, characterized by its imposing structure and intricate details. Its sharply curved, soaring đầu đao and massive gỗ lim columns, painted in a deep brown hue, command attention.
